question_text: A depot gives a reward on every 20th standard rental and every 30th powered rental it accepts. Describe the state and algorithm changes needed to an add-rental operation. Count only successful additions and keep separate counts for each depot.
adaptation_rationale: Persistent object-state and conditional counter reasoning supported. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Store two instance counters initialized to 0. After successful addition, identify rental kind and increment only its counter. If its updated count is divisible by the appropriate threshold, call the reward operation once. Do not count failed additions.

marking_points.criterion: Identifies type and increments matching counter.
Tests updated count against correct multiple.
Issues exactly one reward when threshold condition holds.
